reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original B1/B2 noun exercises: checked complete German sentences, nominalized adjective forms, all offered distractors, unique answers, bilingual hints/explanations and distinct contexts. Reviewed pinned source labels and production/initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion objectives. Corrected inherited Erzieher gender/example mismatch and avoided archaic/overly complex examples. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending. Second editorial pass clarified hypothesis testing in the Experiment question and replaced the nonstandard Rückauftrag distractor with Wiederholungsauftrag.
